mechanism.rho_basis: prereg §2.1 REFUTES covers 「非单方向」「多维表征」 explicitly; this entry asserts refusal is better described by cones than by one linear direction
mechanism.claim: Refusal is mediated by high-dimensional polyhedral cones in activation space, not by a single linear direction.
mechanism.quote: We establish that refusal behaviors can be better understood via high-dimensional polyhedral cones in activation space rather than a single linear direction, highlighting their complex spatial structures.

mechanism.rho_basis: the paper's own framing sentence denying the single-direction reading; several independent directions and cones all mediate refusal
mechanism.claim: Multiple independent directions - and multi-dimensional concept cones - mediate refusal.
mechanism.quote: Contrary to prior work, we uncover multiple independent directions and even multi-dimensional concept cones that mediate refusal.

mechanism.rho_basis: distinct mechanisms behind each independent direction contradicts the necessity-and-sufficiency of one direction (the anchor's own coded claim)
mechanism.claim: Within the space of representationally independent directions, several refusal directions exist and correspond to distinct mechanisms.
mechanism.quote: Additionally, we introduce representational independence and show that within this space of independent directions multiple refusal directions exist and correspond to distinct mechanisms.

mechanism.rho_basis: the quote alone settles nothing about the *number* of refusal directions; it attacks the inference from orthogonality to independence, so under §2.1 it is recorded UNDECIDABLE rather than counted as a direction vote
mechanism.claim: Orthogonality of activation directions does not license a causal-independence conclusion under intervention; an explicit independence notion is needed.
mechanism.quote: Moreover, we show that orthogonality alone does not imply independence under intervention, motivating the notion of representational independence that accounts for both linear and non-linear effects.

record.mapping_note: paper's 'refusal direction / concept cone' -> our K2 gate (L2 representational mediation), its 'multiple independent directions with distinct mechanisms' -> K3 competition and K4 conjunction; 'orthogonality does not imply independence' -> K10 role re-ordering of the independence criterion (MAPPING: the paper never uses our vocabulary).
record.description_scope: Judged as a claim about which representation-level structures gate emission of a harmful completion; it is not a claim about behaviour rates, so no action-level d_axis is coded.
record.motion_source: L2 - geometry of residual-stream activation directions (gradient-optimised directions and cones), not a behaviour measurement.
record.event_grammar: [MOTION] harmful vs harmless prompt forms a separable activation structure --> [GATE] any direction inside a multi-dimensional cone (not one vector) can strengthen or weaken refusal --> [ACTION/INACTION] emission is gated along several independent mechanisms at once

target_characterization.quote: Prior work suggests that a single refusal direction in the model’s activation space determines whether an LLM refuses a request.
target_characterization.why: it reports the anchor's position rather than asserting a competing one, so no rho is minted for it

label_derivation: R17 label read only off entries whose rho takes a side (§2.1 leaves UNDECIDABLE and UNRELATED directionless); all REFUTES => CONTRADICTED
extraction_note: the body comes from arXiv's LaTeXML HTML; inline math is dropped by tag stripping, so quotes are chosen from sentences that contain no math and a quote is accepted only when it occurs exactly once
stop_rule: identity or extraction short => the exit table decides; no third channel is tried in this round (prereg §4.2), L01-O4 stays open
asymmetry: the competing theory's reading is appended to C-04 and never rewrites an earlier anchor verdict (R6); quotes are located by offset+hash, an offset that misses is an instrument defect, not evidence
